outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells, but individual data points from the four mice per group are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlays since overlaying points would make it unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance by day at 5w, 9w, 21w), which are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel G shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel H shows bar charts of mean ± SD (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) calculated from nine mice per group, but no individual data points are overlaid on either bar chart.
